verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Stagehand can start a single browser via Browserbase, local launch, or CDP attach, and it mentions Browserbase regions and a session dashboard. Nothing documents running many concurrent sessions, any concurrency limits, or programmatic management of a session fleet. Single-browser launch and Browserbase's dashboard are adjacent or host-platform features, not this capability.

support.subject: As an automation-engineer, I can run a fleet of concurrent browser sessions with documented concurrency limits and programmatic session management
